AgeBands.description: 1.7 (AA-1075, bk-15): the oldest age (in whole years on the departure date) at the child and infant prices.
AgeBands.title: AgeBands

AgeBandsBody.description: bk-047 (AA-1075, bk-15): the oldest ages at the child and infant prices (None = the default).
AgeBandsBody.title: AgeBandsBody

AgencyInvoice.description: 1.5 (AA-1037). The invoice with its lines, the approved payments and the issuer (how to pay).
AgencyInvoice.title: AgencyInvoice

AgencyInvoiceSummary.description:
1.5 (AA-1037). One AA invoice of the calling agency (issued, paid or void; a draft is never shown). Amounts in
the invoice currency; ``period_end`` is the last day the invoice covers.
AgencyInvoiceSummary.title: AgencyInvoiceSummary

document_ref.description: the evidence: statement line, slip, file id
document_ref.title: Document Ref

BillingStatus.description:
1.5 (AA-1037). The agency's credit status (as ``PartnerTerms.credit``) and the last day its software fee is
paid for.
BillingStatus.title: BillingStatus

BookingConfirmation.description: 1.3 (AA-1037 G2): the booking confirmation of a "Book with AA" booking. No traveller names, no prices.
BookingConfirmation.title: BookingConfirmation

BookingVouchers.description: 1.7 (AA-1075): one service voucher per confirmed supplier booking. No traveller names, no prices.
BookingVouchers.title: BookingVouchers

CancellationPolicy.description:
1.3 (AA-1037 G1): the fee schedule of a cancel. ``in_force_today`` = what a confirm today would lock;
``locked`` = locked on the confirmed booking (its cancel charges by it). Tiers by ``min_days`` descending.
CancellationPolicy.title: CancellationPolicy

Channel.description: Sales channel of a quote (ADR 0005 decision 4 table).
Channel.title: Channel

CommercialBody.description: Every commercial field (PUT): a field left out is cleared, except ``supplier_id`` (left out = kept, AA-996).
CommercialBody.title: CommercialBody

status.description: publish a draft (second person) or expire a published contract; on its own
status.title: Status

net_amount.description: supplier net cost in net_currency; 0 for an included item
net_amount.title: Net Amount

supplier_rate_id.description: the published rate this line comes from
supplier_rate_id.title: Supplier Rate Id

DepartureFeeCharge.description: 1.8 (AA-1073 rest). A departure fee AA charged the calling agency (minimum shortfall, unreleased allotment).
DepartureFeeCharge.title: DepartureFeeCharge

DepartureGenerateIn.description: AA-1073 (bk-02): departures of a weekly or monthly pattern; dates the plan already has are skipped.
DepartureGenerateIn.title: DepartureGenerateIn

DeployGate.description:
Read by ``.github/scripts/booking-deploy-preflight.sh``. ``by_status`` / ``by_kind`` count active jobs
(information); ``blocking_running`` / ``blocking_due`` count the running and the due queued rows of the
deploy-blocking kinds, which decide ``safe_to_deploy``.
DeployGate.title: DeployGate

DestinationPatch.description: Booking state of one CIS place; a field left out keeps its value. ``status = active`` clears the reason.
DestinationPatch.title: DestinationPatch

InvoiceIssuer.description: The AA entity that issued the invoice, as snapshotted at issue, with how to pay it.
InvoiceIssuer.title: InvoiceIssuer

costs.description: replaces the item's net cost lines; omit to keep them (or to take the rate in force)
costs.title: Costs

hotel_room_type_id.description: the hotel room type this item books
hotel_room_type_id.title: Hotel Room Type Id

id.description: keep an existing item (and what references it)
id.title: Id

LineReduction.description: 1.7 (AA-1075): a partial cancellation: fewer travellers on one line, its fee and refundable part.
LineReduction.title: LineReduction

departure.description: the departure whose shared costs the bill covers (never with trip_case)
departure.title: Departure

trip_case.description: trip case code or UUID, when one
trip_case.title: Trip Case

NewMedia.description: A supplier photo, as base64 JSON (API Gateway passes no binary body; see ``app.supply.media``).

data_base64.description: the image bytes, base64 (at most 4194304 characters: image_too_large)
data_base64.title: Data Base64

usage_rights.description: contracting confirmed AA may publish this photo
usage_rights.title: Usage Rights

NewMedia.title: NewMedia

reference.description: bank or receipt reference, never a card
reference.title: Reference

OverrideApproveIn.description: The lower fee % the approver saw; a different stored value (asked again in between) is refused (409).
OverrideApproveIn.title: OverrideApproveIn

PartnerTerms.description:
1.3 (AA-1037 G6): the agency's terms with AA as data: payment terms, credit status, the default cancellation
policy in force and the approved clauses (a draft clause is never shown).
PartnerTerms.title: PartnerTerms

PriceRowIn.description: One price matrix row: the selling price per person, or the net cost per person to price it from (AA-996).

amount.description: price per person; with a net cost, an override
amount.title: Amount

computed.description: a cost sheet row sent back as read; with an amount it becomes overridden
computed.title: Computed

net_amount.description: net cost per person to price the row from
net_amount.title: Net Amount

PriceRowIn.title: PriceRowIn

RateSheetUpload.description: The filled template as base64 (the staff BFF forwards JSON bodies only, like supplier photos).
RateSheetUpload.title: RateSheetUpload

Readiness.description:
``status`` ``ok`` / ``not_ready``; ``db`` ``ok`` / ``error`` / ``not_configured``. ``error`` is the exception
class name only; ``required_schema_version`` and ``missing_schema_versions`` appear when a required ``bk-NNN``
migration is not registered. ``registered_keys``: every registered ``bk-NNN``, sorted, whenever the
schema read succeeded (read by the Deploy Dev schema gate). ``storage``: ``supply_media`` / ``ops_docs``,
each ``configured`` / ``not_configured`` (the bucket env reached the task or not; never the bucket name).
Informational: it never turns ``status`` to ``not_ready`` (without a bucket only the upload routes answer 503).
Readiness.title: Readiness

Tariff.description: 1.4 (AA-1030 G3). The calling agency's own tariff: its price per tour, season and pax band.
Tariff.title: Tariff

TariffItem.description:
1.4 (AA-1030 G3). One price matrix window x pax band of a tour, cut where a supplier rate changes (every
departure from ``valid_from`` to ``valid_to`` prices the same), priced as ``POST /quotes`` would price the plan's
``tp:`` line for the band's smallest party on ``priced_for_date`` (= ``valid_from``).
TariffItem.title: TariffItem

UseForTripCase.description:
``trip_case`` (a case UUID or code) gets a new version from the plan. Without it the request asked for a new
staff-made case, a B2C case retired with the B2C half (AA-1046): 410 ``b2b_only``.
UseForTripCase.title: UseForTripCase
